A [[human]] served as a '''box guard''' in an [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] part of a [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Narkina" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he<ref name="Narkina" /> was [[Death|killed]] in a [[Narkina 5 prison escape|prison escape]] by the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]].<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The box guard first appeared in the [[Andor Season 1|''Andor'' Season 1]] episode "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina" /> which released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Kingsley Amadi]] and credited as "Box Guard Right."<ref name="Narkina" />
